card: MCP start_sim and preflight run beside the daemon: route them through it
deviations_from_card: 8 cases (7 + the revision's reverse mismatch). Case 4 asserts the run reached the daemon's live registry via live.get(id) OR the registry's latest slot, because a scripted run can finish before the assertion; plus MCP running() empty and wait_idle returning within 1 s. Case 6 compares (check,state) rows, not detail text. engine_mismatch uses code 'conflict'. mcp.rs needed no change (premise mcp.rs line refs were stale; run_stdio unchanged). Coupled file: integrations/mod.rs (module declaration). Existing mcp tests now point cfg.daemon.port at a closed port so a developer's daemon on 7717 cannot hijack them. A daemon that answers the probe then fails mid-call is 'unavailable' (never retried in-process); a daemon answering engine.status with an error refuses the call (tightens).
notes: cargo fmt --all -- --check rc=1 only on sibling in-flight files (crates/shadowrunr-segments/src/runtime.rs, tests/runtime.rs - segments-runtime B); my files pass rustfmt --check. First cargo test --workspace run failed with 'could not execute process' on the daemon test exe (file lock from a concurrent build); rerun rc=0. No network beyond 127.0.0.1, no LLM calls: the live-daemon test builds a fleet that is never called. Runner-up (activity follows the latest watch slot) not touched.
